# `palette`

What each character of a map stands for, shared between maps (10 §3.2).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `entries` (object, name → [`EntryDef`](#entrydef); **required**): Entries by character.

<a id="entrydef"></a>
### `EntryDef`

A palette value: one cell spec, or weighted alternatives.

Written as a state, a cell spec or a list of alternatives.

Takes (kept with where it was written, and checked when mods load):

- a string
- an object: object [`SpecObject`](#specobject)
- a list: list of [`AltItem`](#altitem)

<a id="specobject"></a>
### `SpecObject`

A cell spec written as an object (10 §3.2): what is put in the cell, layer by layer, or weighted alternatives.

- `floor` (string, or `null`; optional): The floor's element state (02 §5.1).
- `block` (string, or `null`; optional): The block's element state.
- `fixture` (string, or `null`; optional): The fixture's element state.
- `clear` (list of string; optional): Layers emptied: `floor`, `block`, `fixture`, and of what else a cell holds `conduits`, `fields`, `items`, `decals`, `vars`.
- `keep` (list of string; optional): Element layers (`floor`, `block`, `fixture`) left as the world has them.
- `conduits` (list of string; optional): Conduits laid in the cell (16 §6).
- `field` (object, name → number; optional): Field amounts (02 §16), by field id.
- `items` ([`ItemsField`](#itemsfield), or `null`; optional): Items, or a content table: an item id, or `{ "item": id }` or `{ "table": id }` with `count` and `chance`. In a container fixture they are latent contents (06 §9.3).
- `spawn` ([`SpawnField`](#spawnfield), or `null`; optional): A creature or population member in this cell: a creature id, or `{ "creature": id }` or `{ "population": id }` with `count` and `chance`.
- `device` ([`DeviceField`](#devicefield), or `null`; optional): Configuration for the element's device (16 §4.2), and a name for linking: a name, or `{ "name": text, "config": { … } }`.
- `mark` ([`Names`](#names), or `null`; optional): A named mark the cell is added to, or a list of them.
- `berth` ([`BerthField`](#berthfield), or `null`; optional): A named berth of a kind the cell is added to: a parking bay, a mooring, a landing pad (10 §3.2).
- `approach` (string, or `null`; optional): The berth whose approach line the cell is on: the line an AI driver follows into it (09 §5.6).
- `watched` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether what is placed in the cell is something the site's people keep an eye on (15 §6). Default false.
- `area` (string, or `null`; optional): The kind of area, an `area_kind` id, the cell is added to; touching cells with the same entry are one area.
- `var` (object, name → [`Lit`](#lit); optional): Cell variables (02 §5.1), by name.
- `decal` ([`Names`](#names), or `null`; optional): Decals put on the cell: a name, or a list of them.
- `floor_tag` (string, or `null`; optional): For a map used as a pattern (16 §4.5): any floor carrying this tag.
- `block_tag` (string, or `null`; optional): For a pattern: any block carrying this tag.
- `fixture_tag` (string, or `null`; optional): For a pattern: any fixture carrying this tag.
- `any` (`true` or `false`; optional): For a pattern: anything at all. Default false.
- `weight` ([expression of number](../values.md#expressions), or `null`; optional): As one of weighted alternatives: its weight among them, an expression. One if left out.
- `one_of` (list of [`AltItem`](#altitem), or `null`; optional): Weighted alternatives, chosen for each cell, or once for the whole placement with `once`.
- `once` (`true` or `false`; optional): With `one_of`: whether one alternative is chosen for the whole placement rather than for each cell. Default false.

<a id="altitem"></a>
### `AltItem`

One alternative as written inside a list.

Written as a state or a cell spec.

Takes (kept with where it was written, and checked when mods load):

- a string
- an object: object [`SpecObject`](#specobject)

Takes (kept with where it was written, and checked when mods load):

- a string
- an object: object [`ItemsDef`](#itemsdef)

<a id="spawnfield"></a>

- a string

### `DeviceField`

The `device` field of a cell spec: a name, or a `DeviceDef`.

Written as a device name or an object.

<a id="names"></a>
### `Names`

One name or a list of them: `"bed"` or `["bed", "guest_bed"]`.

Written as a name or a list of names.

Takes (kept with where it was written, and checked when mods load):

- a string
- a list: list of string

<a id="berthfield"></a>
### `BerthField`

The `berth` field of a cell spec: a name, or a `BerthDef`.

Written as a berth name or an object.

Takes (kept with where it was written, and checked when mods load):

- a string
- an object: object [`BerthDef`](#berthdef)

<a id="lit"></a>
### `Lit`

A plain value written in data: `true`, `3`, `0.5` or a text.

Written as a number, a boolean or a text.

Takes:

- a string
- an integer
- a number
- a boolean

<a id="itemsdef"></a>
### `ItemsDef`

Items laid in a cell: an item, or a content table (10 §3.2).

- `item` (string, or `null`; optional): The id of one item definition.
- `table` (string, or `null`; optional): The id of a content table.
- `count` ([`CountDef`](#countdef), or `null`; optional): How many. One if left out.
- `chance` ([expression of number](../values.md#expressions), or `null`; optional): The chance that there is anything. Certain if left out.

<a id="spawnwhodef"></a>
### `SpawnWhoDef`

Who is spawned: a creature or a member of a population (06 §12).

- `creature` (string, or `null`; optional): The id of a creature definition.
- `population` (string, or `null`; optional): The id of a population definition.
- `count` ([`CountDef`](#countdef), or `null`; optional): How many. One if left out.
- `chance` ([expression of number](../values.md#expressions), or `null`; optional): The chance that anyone is there. Certain if left out.
- `in` (string, or `null`; optional): For an entry of a map's `spawns`: the area they are spread through.
- `at` ([`PointDef`](#pointdef), or `null`; optional): For an entry of a map's `spawns`: the cell or mark they stand at.

<a id="devicedef"></a>
### `DeviceDef`

A device's configuration and the name it is linked by (10 §3.2, §3.6; 16 §4.2).

- `name` (string, or `null`; optional): The name `wiring.links` refer to it by.
- `config` (object, name → [`Lit`](#lit); optional): Settings handed to the device when it is made.

<a id="berthdef"></a>
### `BerthDef`

A berth a cell belongs to (10 §3.2).

- `name` (string; **required**): The berth's name within the map.
- `kind` (string; optional): What kind of berth it is: a parking bay, a mooring. Free text.

<a id="countdef"></a>
### `CountDef`

How many: a number, `[low, high]`, or an expression.

Written as a count: a number, `[low, high]` or an expression.

Takes (kept with where it was written, and checked when mods load):

- a string: [expression of int](../values.md#expressions)
- an object: [expression of int](../values.md#expressions)
- an integer: [expression of int](../values.md#expressions)
- a number: [expression of int](../values.md#expressions)
- a list: list of whole number

<a id="pointdef"></a>
### `PointDef`

A point of a map: a cell `[x, y]` or `[x, y, level]`, or a mark, `"mark:name"`.

Written as a cell `[x, y, level]` or a mark `"mark:name"`.

Takes (kept with where it was written, and checked when mods load):

- a string
- a list: list of whole number
